The conductance Laplacian B=diag(Omega)K diag(Omega) simultaneously gives the pinned bosonic/GFF precision, the electrical representation d_u F_h=-diag(Omega^2)phi for B phi=h, and the exact nonlinear action score grad A=-B(r/Omega^2). The source covector is Riemannian parallel, so all Green-kernel derivatives cancel against the Levi-Civita connection and its Witten numerator is exactly E[(D_h S)^2]=E[D_h^2 S], reproducing omega(p)^2||h||^2/lambda^2 at the vacuum. The actual annealed Witten lower bound or full-Witten low-Rayleigh sequence, lowest-mode moment, H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open.
